_about: Earlier editions on the MICHELIN Guide results pages (/guides/michelin-guide-…/), saved by `python3 build.py --freeze <guide id>` before a new ceremony's changes go into the restaurant files. Per guide id (as in ceremonies.json), newest first: the ceremony's date and edition, restaurant file names with their stars (new, up and down also give the stars before; gone the stars it held), and the star counts [one, two, three] before and after. Written by the build; edit only to fix a mistake.
